title: fix(plugin-security,service-realtime): name the person, not the raw user id, in the sys_user_position and sys_presence record titles
body:
Fixes #32106

Ruling (maintainer, recorded in #32106 comment 6768568963): option A. The position half keeps the catalog machine name, the same shape as the shipped `sys_user_permission_set` title, so this PR closes the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`sys_user_position` 与 `sys_presence` 的记录标题不再显示原始 user id,改为显示用户姓名(姓名为空时显示邮箱);`sys_presence` 的状态也改为显示选项标签(如 "Away")。
- 为什么改:Setup 的 User Positions 列表、记录页标题和审计日志的 Record 列都显示 `v34DfZXy… → showcase_exec` 这种看不懂的文本;本 PR 让「谁」这一半变成人名。职位那一半仍显示职位 API 名,因为公式无法读取安全目录里的职位标签,需要你裁决(见卡片上的决策问题)。
- 风险与回滚:标题在读取时计算、不落库,存量行无需迁移;读者无权读取该用户时标题为空,不泄露姓名(与 `sys_user_permission_set` 同一机制)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-position.object.ts` 的 `display_title` 表达式;② `packages/services/service-realtime/src/objects/sys-presence.object.ts` 的 `display_title`(含 `label(record.status)`);③ `sys-security-assignment-display-title.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/objects/sys-security-assignment-display-title.test.ts`,预期 8 个用例全绿,其中标题读作 `QA Member S2 → showcase_contributor`。
- 需要你做的:对卡片上「职位标签」那一半的决策问题选一个选项(本 PR 本身:无,席位落地)。

## What changes

- `sys_user_position.display_title` was `record.user_id + ' → ' + record.position`. It now reads the person one hop through `user_id`, which is the mechanism `sys_user_permission_set` (`sys-user-permission-set.object.ts`, pinned by `sys-user-permission-set-person-title.test.ts`) and `sys_business_unit_member` (`business-unit-member-title.test.ts`) already use: `(isBlank(trim(record.user_id.name)) ? record.user_id.email : record.user_id.name) + ' → ' + record.position`. The list Title column, the record page H1 and the audit log Record cell all read this field.
- `sys_presence.display_title` was `record.user_id + ' (' + record.status + ')'`. It uses the same hop and now reads the status through `label(record.status)`, because `status` is a select that declares options. Example: `QA Member S2 (Away)`.
- The title is a formula field. It is computed on read and has no stored column, so existing rows show the new title with no recompute and no migration (this was measured: see Tests).
- The hop is evaluated as the READER. If the reader may not read the user, the title is null and neither the name nor the email reaches the row. If the user no longer exists, the title is also null. Both cases are pinned.
- The `description` text of both fields is unchanged, so no i18n bundle is regenerated (`pnpm check:i18n` reports the bundles in sync).

## Tests

- `sys-security-assignment-display-title.test.ts` is re-pinned with its assertions rewritten to the precedent's shape, through the real engine with the real `sys_user`. It checks: the hop-only reads (`position`, `user_id.email`, `user_id.name`); the person's name on the write response, on `findOne`, on a projected `find`, and from `resolveRecordDisplayName` / `servedRecordTitle`; the email fallback for a blank name; reader-scoped null with no leak; null for a dangling user; required-column refusal; no stored column and no search companion column.
- `sys-presence-display-title.test.ts` is re-pinned statically, because service-realtime has no engine in its dependency closure. It checks that the formula reads `user_id` only through the hop, that it reads `status` only through `label()` on a field that declares options, and that each column it reads is required and not withheld.

Results at head `f0917a51` (code commit `a5c0d278`; the later commit only adds the changeset):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: Test Files 258 passed (258), Tests 6215 passed, 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-realtime test`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 36 passed.
- `typecheck` passes for both packages. In plugin-security the typecheck includes `check:test-typecheck`, so the test layer is compiled too.

<details><summary>Ablation (one shot, committed fix first, restored to HEAD blob)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` was used to swap each new expression back to the old raw-id expression. Neither pin needs a rebuild, because both import the object from `src` through a relative path.

- sys_user_position: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 4ca10d78c1b6 -> 6d5df89a5572. The pin went red with 6 failed and 2 passed (8). After restore, the blob equals HEAD (4ca10d78c1b6) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- sys_presence: the mutation landed (blob f09453781d14 -> d8ed76e6d6b8). The pin went red with 1 failed and 2 passed (3). After restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>One-shot engine measurement (scratch test, deleted, not committed)</summary>

A scratch suite registered `SysUser`, `SysUserPosition` and `SysPresence` on a real ObjectQL engine with an in-memory SQL driver:

- the new `sys_user_position` title read `"QA Member S2 → showcase_contributor"`
- the new `sys_presence` title read `"QA Member S2 (Away)"`. This is the presence rendered text that the package's own suite cannot evaluate.
- on main (`0f7389cc`) the same reads gave `"Nb8ZwCw0hvJG1L1G → showcase_contributor"` and `"Nb8ZwCw0hvJG1L1G (away)"`.
- `label(record.position)`:
  - `validateExpression` refused it with `code: label-field-no-options` ("`position` declares no options, so it has no option label").
  - The real engine read it as `null` and logged the formula fault at WARN.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The position label is not delivered (ruled A: keep the machine name, #32106 comment 6768568963).** The triage ruling asks for the position LABEL ("Contributor"), but no formula can reach it. `position` is a text column that stores a security-catalog name. It is not a lookup, because the `sys_position` table was retired from the plugin (ADR-0131 C3). It is not a select either, so it declares no options. As a result, `label(record.position)` is refused when authored and reads null when evaluated. The catalog label is resolved only by the console's `position-ref` widget. Delivering it means changing the formula engine or the option-label pinning (`@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/objectql` `formula-option-labels.ts`) so that it can serve catalog labels for a catalog-ref field. That is outside this card's file surface, and the dispatch says not to widen into the engine. The options are listed on the card in the dev report.
- The same gap applies to `sys_user_permission_set`, whose title still shows the `permission_set` machine name for the same reason.

## Verification

- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, no paths, 5 paths vs merge base `0f7389cc`) were run locally at `f0917a51`.
  - Exit 0: every family except the three listed below.
  - `check:i18n`: first run was PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3). After building the closure the gate printed, it exited 0 with "all bundles in sync".
  - NOT MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`. Reason: it exited 3 because the shallow clone cannot reach the pinned positive-control commit. CI runs it.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. Reason: it exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) because it needs a full `pnpm build` of 60+ packages. This narrowing is declared, and CI runs it.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` (one family per line, with its exit code): "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. The dispatch asked for this run. It is a repo-wide scan that CI also runs.
- Full dogfood: n/a. The title has no `!` and Clause-② has no (narrowing) arm.
